title: Kontor Context Pack v1
description: The canonical document a Context Pack preview and a started snapshot are hashed from. It carries the resolved pack, the winning source of every leaf and the redaction report. It never carries a redacted value, a hash of a redacted value, a source handle or a provider-native session locator. The digest of the canonical serialization of this document (compact UTF-8, object keys sorted, array order preserved) is the only Context Pack hash.

schema_version.description: The envelope contract this document was written under.

realm_id.description: The realm every source belonged to.

pack.description: The resolved context, after restricted-reference admission and after redaction. Redacted paths are absent, not nulled.

provenance.description: The winning source of every resolved leaf, ordered by path. Exactly one entry exists per leaf; a leaf is any non-object value plus an empty object. No entry survives for a replaced or redacted subtree.

redactions.description: Every applied redaction, ordered by path then declaring source. Metadata only.

sourceKey.description: A stable, deployment-defined source key. Unique within its layer — the same key may contribute at several layers, each with its own precedence rank — and the secondary sort key, so `(layer, source_id)` totally orders the sources and caller collection order cannot reach the result.

jsonPointer.description: An RFC 6901 pointer into the resolved pack.

contextLayer.description: The approved resolution order, weakest first. A caller supplies a layer, never a numeric priority.

redactionReason.description: Why a path was removed. A reason code is metadata about a value that is already gone.

revision.description: The immutable revision of the winning source.

redactionRecord.description: Path, declaring source and reason code. There is deliberately no value, no digest of the value and no length: the report says that a path was dropped and why, never what was there.
